decisions.label: Creature momentum
decisions.note: Creatures chasing her turn no faster than their limit, react to where she was a moment ago and lead her only with telegraphed attacks (Ed, 2026-10-27: "less worth dodging because animals can turn towards her instantly"). Off: as before. Each species' own numbers are its class's (heavy, normal, light) or its folder's; these sliders scale them all.

decisions.label: Turn rate ×
decisions.note: Times every species' turn limit (creatureMomentum.turn; 1 as built: heavy 220°/s, normal 420, light 650, falling as turn / (1 + speed / k)). Lower: wider arcs, more overshoot on a sidestep; higher: they cut back sooner.

decisions.label: Reaction delay ×
decisions.note: Times every species' reaction delay (creatureMomentum.delay; 1 as built: heavy 0.4 s, normal 0.25, light 0.15): it chases where she was that long ago, so a sidestep or blink fools it for that long. 0: it sees her at once.

decisions.label: Chase lead +s
decisions.note: Seconds of her velocity every species leads her by when just chasing, added to its own (creatureMomentum.chaseLead; 0 as built: no prediction, only the wolf leads a little, 0.15 s). Ed: prediction mostly for telegraphed attacks.

decisions.label: Telegraphed lead ×
decisions.note: Times the lead telegraphed attacks take on her (creatureMomentum.strikeLead; 1 as built, as they were): a melee wind-up's tracking, a charge's lane, a leap, a swoop's dive, shots and lobs. 0: they aim where she is.
